---
title: "GMWI2 Taxa Prevalence Heatmap — Cross-Population"
author: "Vy Nguyen"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  run_name:         "HGM_study"
  output_dir:       "output"
  top_n:            50           # number of top taxa to display
  core_cutoff:      0            # minimum prevalence in reference population
  this_study_label: "This study" # substring to identify reference population column
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

run_name          <- params$run_name
output_dir        <- params$output_dir
top_n             <- params$top_n
core_cutoff       <- params$core_cutoff
this_study_label  <- params$this_study_label
prefix            <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
# GMWI2 scores file: rows = taxa, columns = populations (prevalence values)
df <- read_excel(here("data", "gmwi2_scores.xlsx"), sheet = "gmwi2_taxa")

names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
pop_cols  <- setdiff(names(df), "Taxa")

# Identify reference population column
ref_col <- grep(this_study_label, pop_cols, value = TRUE,
                ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
if (is.na(ref_col)) stop("Reference population column not found.")

cat("Populations:", paste(pop_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Reference column:", ref_col, "\n")
cat("Taxa:", nrow(df), "\n")

# Coerce all population columns to numeric
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pop_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(TotalPrev = rowSums(across(all_of(pop_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))
```

## 2. Select Top Taxa

```{r select-taxa}
# Taxa present in reference population
core_ref   <- df %>% filter(.data[[ref_col]] >= core_cutoff)

# Additional taxa from other populations (not already in core_ref)
other_core <- df %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(setdiff(pop_cols, ref_col)), ~ .x >= core_cutoff)) %>%
  filter(!Taxa %in% core_ref$Taxa) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalPrev))

df_top <- bind_rows(core_ref,
                    head(other_core, max(0, top_n - nrow(core_ref))))

cat("Taxa from reference population:", nrow(core_ref), "\n")
cat("Additional taxa from other cohorts:", nrow(df_top) - nrow(core_ref), "\n")
cat("Total taxa in heatmap:", nrow(df_top), "\n")

# Save summary Excel
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Top_taxa")
writeData(wb, "Top_taxa", df_top)
addWorksheet(wb, "All_taxa_sorted")
writeData(wb, "All_taxa_sorted", df %>% arrange(desc(TotalPrev)))
saveWorkbook(wb,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_taxa_summary.xlsx")),
             overwrite = TRUE)
```

## 3. Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=17}
# Tidy format for ggplot
ordered_pops <- c(ref_col, setdiff(pop_cols, ref_col))

df_long <- df_top %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(pop_cols),
               names_to  = "Population",
               values_to = "Prevalence") %>%
  mutate(Population = factor(Population, levels = ordered_pops))

# Order taxa by prevalence in reference population (descending)
taxa_order <- df_long %>%
  filter(Population == ref_col) %>%
  arrange(desc(Prevalence)) %>%
  pull(Taxa)

df_long$Taxa <- factor(df_long$Taxa, levels = rev(taxa_order))

# Set color scale
fill_var <- "Prevalence"
fill_label <- "Prevalence (0–1)"
scale_layer <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("#f7fcf5", "#c7e9c0", "#74c476", "#238b45", "#00441b"),
  limits = c(0,1),
  name = fill_label)

# Plot heatmap
p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Population, y = Taxa, fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
  #geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.75, height = 0.8) +
  geom_tile(color = NA, width = 1, height = 1)+
  scale_layer +
  labs(
    title = paste0("GMWI2 Taxa Prevalence Across Populations (Top ", top_n, ")"),
    subtitle = paste("Reference:", ref_col),
    x = "Population", y = "Taxa"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9, lineheight = 0.9),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,
                 paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_taxa_heatmap_top", top_n, ".png")),
       p, width = 9, height = 17, dpi = 300)

cat("Heatmap saved.\n")
```

## 4. Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
knitr::kable(df_top[, c("Taxa", pop_cols)],
             digits  = 3,
             caption = paste("Top", top_n, "GMWI2 Taxa — Prevalence by Population"))
```
